custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the hands gripping the rifle. AI often fails to render individual fingers correctly when they wrap around cylindrical objects like gun barrels or grips. Check if the trigger finger is logically positioned. Also, verify if the rifle's mechanical parts (charging handle, ejection port) are on the correct side for the platform depicted (AR-style should have ejection port on the right, which is facing away here, so we should NOT see it; if we see it, it's a mirror error).
